_note: Audit of candidate Chinese clinical datasets. 'verified' says what was actually checked from this environment on the audit date and how; anything not directly verified must be re-checked before use. Hugging Face became reachable on 2026-11-17 and the two entries hosted there were re-verified directly.

datasets.name: CMB-Clin (part of CMB: A Comprehensive Medical Benchmark in Chinese)
datasets.content: 74 complex inpatient teaching cases (history, physical examination, auxiliary examinations) with expert-consensus answers on diagnosis and basis, differential diagnosis and treatment principles; drawn from official medical textbooks
datasets.provenance: textbook teaching cases, not hospital records; no real-patient identifiers expected
datasets.verified: LICENSE file and data/CMB.zip downloaded from the GitHub repository; archive inspected
datasets.redistribution: permitted with licence and attribution notice
permitted_use_here: prompt development on the dev split only
datasets.relevance: very high - same input shape and the same three reasoning outputs as an initial progress note
datasets.limits: 74 cases, surgery-heavy; no reference Case Features text; some cases contain treatment course or pathology that post-dates admission

datasets.name: MedCT-clinical-notes (TigerResearch)
datasets.content: 7,437 real clinical note fragments (median about 67 characters; 5,637 unique of at least 15 characters) with 61,660 entity spans linked to MedCT/SNOMED concept ids; plus 2K discharge notes with search relevance labels and 91 discharge notes with summaries. Fragments are examination findings, discharge advice, diagnosis lists and progress-note passages; there is no patient or encounter id, so they cannot be reassembled into cases
datasets.provenance: real hospital records (Zhejiang tertiary hospital per the paper); the dataset card gives no de-identification statement. Pattern scan of the NER notes: no ID-card or phone numbers, 1 name field, hospital names in about 130 fragments, explicit dates in about 670
datasets.license: Apache-2.0 (dataset card metadata, verified 2026-11-17); not gated
datasets.verified: dataset card, file list and the two NER files downloaded and profiled
datasets.access: open, direct download from Hugging Face
datasets.redistribution: licence permits it, but this is real patient text: project policy is NOT to commit raw or derived text, only aggregate statistics
permitted_use_here: robustness testing of the deterministic text layer (aggregate results only)
datasets.relevance: medium, not the 'very high' first assumed: no admission-record-to-note pairs and no case structure. Valuable as real-language stress data for sentence splitting, units, negation cues and verifier false alarms
datasets.limits: fragments only; entity spans carry no polarity; discharge notes contain final diagnoses and outcomes (leakage) so they are not used as inputs
datasets.status: acquired for stress testing (data_pipeline/medct_stress.py); not standardized into cases

datasets.name: CBLUE (CMeEE, CMeIE, CHIP-CDEE, CHIP-CDN, IMCS-V2, ...)
datasets.content: Chinese biomedical NLU tasks: entity recognition (CMeEE), relation extraction (CMeIE), clinical finding event extraction with polarity (CHIP-CDEE), diagnosis normalisation (CHIP-CDN), dialogue tasks
datasets.provenance: mixed: textbooks, clinical practice text, de-identified EMR fragments, online consultations
datasets.license: code repository Apache-2.0 (LICENSE verified). Data is distributed only through Tianchi (dataId 95414) under that platform's per-dataset terms - NOT verified
datasets.verified: repository LICENSE fetched; on 2026-11-17 the team supplied Tianchi downloads of CHIP-CDEE, CHIP-CDN, CHIP-CTC, CHIP-STS and CHIP-YIER, which were inspected. The archives contain no licence text: use is governed by the Tianchi terms the downloader accepted
datasets.access: Tianchi account, accept terms, manual download
permitted_use_here: CHIP-CDEE: external polarity test for the negation rules (tune on train, report on dev; aggregates only)
datasets.relevance: CHIP-CDEE high for negation (10,899 findings in real EMR sentences labelled 肯定/否定/不确定). CHIP-CDN possible later use for diagnosis-name matching. CHIP-CTC (trial criteria), CHIP-STS (question similarity) and CHIP-YIER (exam and case questions) are not relevant to admission-note generation and are not used
datasets.limits: sentence-level tasks, test labels withheld; terms must be read by the account holder
datasets.status: CHIP-CDEE in use (data_pipeline/cdee_negation.py); raw files local only, never committed

datasets.name: IMCS-21 / IMCS-V2
datasets.content: 4,116 annotated online paediatric consultations (10 diseases): entities, dialogue acts, symptom labels with present/absent/uncertain status, and a structured medical report per dialogue
datasets.license: NO LICENCE FILE in the repository (verified: LICENSE returns 404 on main and master). No licence means no grant: research evaluation at most, no redistribution
datasets.verified: both READMEs fetched; data files are not confirmed to be in the repository; the test set is on Tianchi
datasets.relevance: medium: symptom present/absent/uncertain labels are a good external test of negation and uncertainty handling; outpatient paediatric dialogue is far from inpatient admission records
datasets.limits: domain mismatch; licence absent - ask the authors before any use beyond private evaluation

datasets.name: LungCURE
datasets.content: 1,000 de-identified real multimodal lung-cancer cases from 10+ Chinese hospitals (clinical records, imaging, pathology and genomic reports), Chinese and English; TNM staging and treatment recommendation
datasets.provenance: real hospital records, ethics approval reported (PUMCH)
datasets.license: dataset card tag says MIT (verified 2026-11-17), while the paper page shows CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 - conflicting; treat as the more restrictive until the authors clarify. Access is gated (automatic approval after login and sharing contact details)
datasets.verified: dataset API metadata fetched; README and data require login, not attempted
datasets.access: gated: the account holder must accept the terms personally
datasets.relevance: low-medium: single disease, staging/oncology decision task rather than admission documentation; useful as an out-of-distribution robustness set
datasets.limits: evaluation only; non-commercial; must not be used for training or prompt tuning
datasets.status: not acquired - requires the user's own gated access

datasets.name: CliMedBench
datasets.content: 33,735 questions over 14 clinical scenarios, largely derived from real EHRs of tertiary hospitals (doubly de-identified per the paper)
datasets.provenance: real EHR-derived questions plus exams, guidelines, textbooks
datasets.license: UNVERIFIED; a secondary source says access needs researcher verification
datasets.relevance: medium: question-answer format, includes discharge-summary and case-summary scenarios
datasets.limits: QA rather than record-to-note; access by application

datasets.name: CCKS 2017-2019 Chinese EMR NER (Yidu-S4K)
datasets.url: https://github.com/TJUNLP/CCKScner (code); data from the CCKS / Yidu organisers
datasets.content: about 1,000-1,400 annotated real EMR passages: diseases, imaging and lab tests, operations, drugs, anatomy
datasets.provenance: real EMR passages, de-identified by the organisers
datasets.license: evaluation-agreement only; redistribution by third parties is not authorised - UNVERIFIED here
datasets.relevance: medium for entity extraction evaluation only
datasets.limits: mirrors on the web are not an authorised source

datasets.name: MedCD, CDrugRed, CardioEHR, OEHR
datasets.content: real Chinese EHR collections released under login or data-use agreements
datasets.relevance: unknown until the document types are confirmed
datasets.limits: agreements must be signed by the team
